violations.reason: DocumentController.java violates the obligatory criteria against 'magic' constants. Strings like 'ivan.ivanov@epidem.ru' and 'ca078170-df17-48f8-bca4-d89000a6e87f' are hardcoded inline (e.g., in updateDocument, deleteDocument) instead of being extracted to named constants.

DocumentController.java violates the strict prohibition against storing secrets or PII in plain text. It contains hardcoded PII ('ivan.ivanov@epidem.ru') and a mocked JWT token ('mock-jwt-token-xyz').

The serializeMetadata function in DocumentController.java silently swallows an IOException and returns '{}' without logging the error, which violates the forbidden rule against silent suppression of errors.

The /auth/login endpoint in src/main/java/com/eneik/generated/controller/DocumentController.java fakes success without doing any real authentication work by returning a hardcoded fixture response ('mock-jwt-token-xyz') and a static user object.

The serializeMetadata function in src/main/java/com/eneik/generated/controller/DocumentController.java contains a try/catch block that swallows a real IOException and fakes success by returning a plausible-looking empty JSON object ('{}') instead of properly handling the failure.

The sendAnalyticsExport method in src/main/java/com/eneik/generated/service/DefaultEiosClient.java fakes success by adding records to an in-memory list and logging a completion message ('Exporting X analytics records to EIOS...') when eiosApiUrl is not set, without performing any real data transmission.

The 'Скачать PDF' and 'Скачать DOCX' buttons in frontend/src/components/DocumentSearch.svelte represent an unwired UI slice. They prevent default behavior and trigger a JavaScript alert ('Скачивание PDF начато (эмуляция)...') instead of making a real backend request.

The postComment and sendActualizationRequest functions in frontend/src/components/DocumentSearch.svelte are unwired to the backend. They mutate local state (commentsDb, actualizationSuccess) and silently drop the data without making any API calls.

violations.mustBe: The controller must declare what should happen (knowing-that) and delegate procedural file I/O execution (knowing-how) to a service layer.
violations.performance: Separating routing logic from file I/O operations improves testability and maintains declarative intent.
violations.attractive: Clean architecture boundary between HTTP request handling and procedural file storage.

violations.reason: As identified in PR 63, the client specification requires the frontend UI to be strictly in Russian, but the code still contains non-Russian text such as 'Офлайн-симуляция ON', 'active-фильтры', and 'official-запрос'.

As identified in PR 63, the client specification requires document export to PDF/DOCX formats, but the backend DocumentController completely lacks the corresponding export endpoints to support this feature.

As identified in PR 63, the client specification requires functionality for commenting and sending actualization requests, but the backend lacks any endpoints or database models to process and persist this data.
